summary:
Backend-only P0 retest after iter16 fixes (3 fixes applied: soccer/predictor._grade_from_conf delegation + sports_engine step-function floor + learning_system_v2 mirror floor + bulk DB re-sync). 14 pytest cases. RESULTS: 11 PASSED, 3 FAILED on the same root cause as iter16 (grade drift), DIFFERENT TRIGGER. 

— ITER16 FIXES VERIFIED WORKING: (a) soccer/predictor.py:239 `_grade_from_conf` now returns spec vocabulary — DB distinct grades today are exactly {'Elite Lock','Lock','Pass','Playable','Strong Lock'} with 0 legacy ELITE/A+/A/B+/B/C values. (b) sports_engine step function floor is correctly implemented (lines 297-338) and 99-clamp holds (0 overflow in 281 picks). (c) learning_system_v2 mirror floor + re-grade in apply_v2_to_picks is correct.

— BUT BUG #1 STILL REPRODUCES, ROOT CAUSE MOVED: `_weekly_model_tuning_loop` at server.py:2335-2373 calls `learning_engine.apply_learning` which recomputes `lock_score` (line 263), then the `$set` at server.py:2358-2364 persists {win_probability, lock_score, edge_percent, implied_probability, learning} but **NOT `grade`**. Result: 110 picks per cycle have their lock_score shifted without grade re-sync. The loop fires at every backend boot+180s and weekly. Verified end-to-end:
  T+0  manual validate_and_heal() → 0 wrong_pass
  T+2m Weekly model tuning fires (110 picks re-weighted)
  T+2m DB query → 68 wrong_pass (Soccer 58, MLB 10), lock 88-96 stamped 'Pass'
  T+2m manual validate_and_heal() again → 0 wrong_pass (confirms validator step-5 DOES fix it)

The validator's step-5 unconditional re-grade IS working (manual run clears all 68 → 0) but it only runs every 30 min in the settlement loop. The user-visible drift window is therefore up to 30 min wide after every backend restart and after every 7-day weekly cycle. Today the count of 68 wrong_pass was sitting LIVE on /api/picks/today (67 in the returned 115-pick page).

— FIX #4 (auto-expand tight window) — NOW VERIFIED WORKING. window_hours=4 returns 3 parlays with auto_expanded_to=72; window=6 same; window=8 served from 8h alone (auto_expanded_to=None). The escalation path is exercised end-to-end.

— FIX #5 (high-risk 72h) — STILL WORKING. 3 cards × 9 legs each, survival 15.7–16.0%.

— FIX #6 (sort toggle) — STILL WORKING. lock-desc top non-elite [98,98,98,97.9,97.9,...]; lock-asc top [87.1,89.3,...]; edge/time/win all monotonic; desc vs asc top-10 IDs differ.

critical.issue: Grade drift root cause has MOVED from soccer pipeline to weekly model tuning. apply_learning() at learning_engine.py:262-263 recomputes lock_score, then server.py:2358-2364 persists with `$set` that includes lock_score/win_probability/edge_percent/implied_probability/learning but OMITS grade. 110 picks per cycle get a new lock_score with a stale grade attached. The loop runs at every backend boot+180s, so every restart re-triggers this. Manually re-running validate_and_heal() clears the drift, proving step-5 reconcile is functional — the issue is purely the $set payload being incomplete in this loop. FIX: in server.py:2358-2364, add `'grade': _grade(p.get('lock_score'))` and `'confidence': _confidence(p.get('lock_score'))` to the $set dict (import `_grade, _confidence` from sports_engine at top of file). Alternatively call `await apply_v2_to_picks([p], db)` before the $set so step-5 re-grade fires on the updated lock_score. The 30-min validator catches it eventually but the user-visible window after each restart is ~30 min wide.

minor.issue: Step-5 unconditional grade re-sync DOES work in code (line 197-212) but the counts dict at line 42-45 doesn't include 'fixed_grade' as a default key, and the `counts.setdefault('fixed_grade', 0)` at line 206 is inside an `if gx != p.get('grade'):` branch. Result: when validator runs and finds NO grades to fix (because weekly_tuning hasn't fired yet that cycle), the log line drops 'fixed_grade' entirely. Minor observability issue — make 'fixed_grade': 0 a default in counts to keep log shape stable.

8h window today is rich enough that auto_expanded_to=None (3 parlays served directly). Not a bug — code path correct — but the escalation isn't exercised in the 8h branch. 4h and 6h both fired auto_expanded_to=72 correctly.

action_items:
FIX (CRITICAL) — server.py:2358-2364 `_weekly_model_tuning_loop` $set must include grade + confidence after apply_learning. Minimal patch:
   from sports_engine import _grade, _confidence
   await db.picks.update_one(
       {'id': p['id']},
       {'$set': {
           'win_probability': p['win_probability'],
           'lock_score': p.get('lock_score'),
           'edge_percent': p.get('edge_percent'),

           'grade': _grade(float(p.get('lock_score') or 0)),
           'confidence': _confidence(float(p.get('lock_score') or 0)),
           'learning': p.get('learning')}})
   This addresses the iter17 reproduction directly. Alternative: call `await apply_v2_to_picks([p], db)` BEFORE the $set so the step-function floor + step-5 re-grade fires on the new lock.

Run: `grep -rn "'lock_score':" backend/ --include='*.py' | grep -v _grade` to surface them.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app && SOCCER_WAIT_S=300 python -m pytest backend/tests/test_p0_bugs_iteration17.py -v -s --tb=line. The 3 failing tests will PASS once server.py:2358-2364 includes grade+confidence in the $set (see action item #1). The cross-cycle stability test deliberately waits for a soccer/validator marker in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log; if no marker fires in the wait window (default 180s) it still re-audits, which is how iter17 caught the bug — the drift appeared between pre-audit (0 bad) and post-audit (68 bad) with NO soccer/validator marker, proving the source is something else (weekly_tuning). To force-reproduce on demand: `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, wait 3-4 min for _weekly_model_tuning_loop to fire (`grep 'Weekly model tuning' /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log`), then re-query DB — expect ~68 wrong_pass picks. rca_of_issue:
RCA (iter17): The iter16 fix correctly closed the SOCCER PIPELINE leak (soccer/predictor._grade_from_conf now returns spec vocabulary), and the step-function floor + apply_v2_to_picks step-5 re-grade are all in place. However, a THIRD code path also mutates lock_score and was never audited: `_weekly_model_tuning_loop` at server.py:2335-2373.

Flow:
  1. Loop sleeps 180s after backend boot, then runs once per boot (and weekly thereafter).
  2. For each open pick it calls `apply_learning(db, p)` from learning_engine.py.
  3. apply_learning recomputes lock_score via `compute_lock_score(factors, win_prob=new_wp)` and assigns to `pick['lock_score']` (line 263). It does NOT set `pick['grade']`.
  4. The loop's `$set` payload (server.py:2358-2364) persists win_probability, lock_score, edge_percent, implied_probability, learning — but NOT grade.
  5. Result: stored grade is now stale relative to new lock_score → lock 91.5 + grade='Pass' rows appear in DB.

Observed timeline today:
  10:13:05 Weekly tuning → 110 picks re-weighted → drift introduced
  10:16:43 Validator → fixed_grade: 34 (reconciliation runs every 30 min)
  10:17:33 Weekly tuning → drift re-introduced
  10:25:04 Validator runs but DB had been validated manually just before, so 'fixed_grade' key not emitted
  10:25:53 Weekly tuning → drift re-introduced (110 picks re-weighted)
  10:27:35 Manual validate_and_heal() → 0 wrong_pass
  10:29:15 Weekly tuning fires again (this boot's 180s timer) → 68 wrong_pass live on API+DB

Mitigation: server.py:2358-2364 $set must include `grade` and `confidence` derived from the new lock_score, OR the loop must call `apply_v2_to_picks([p], db)` before the $set. Either restores coherence at write time and eliminates the up-to-30-min drift window between weekly_tuning and validator passes.

Note on validator reporting: pick_validator's counts dict (line 42-45) doesn't pre-init 'fixed_grade', so when step-5 reconciles 0 grades the metric vanishes from the log line. This is purely cosmetic but confused initial debugging — at 10:25:04 the validator output looked like it had skipped step-5 entirely; in fact step-5 ran but had nothing to fix (state had been re-validated moments before). Fix: pre-init 'fixed_grade': 0 in counts.
